name: Time Stop Probe
description: A probe, not a release: F7 stops the enemies within 50 m for 5 s, each press with the next method (1 stun only, 2 stun and their animation switched off, 3 the animation off alone), and logs what it found. For the Hakumen plan's time stop. Solo or host. The pose part needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Settings in timestop-probe.ini.
